text: Continuous Integration (CI) is a practice where developers regularly add their code to a shared repository. Every time they do this, automated builds start, which means the software is compiled and prepared without anyone doing it by hand. The CI pipeline then runs tests automatically to check that everything works correctly. This helps teams catch issues early, before they become big problems. Because problems are found quickly, they are easier and cheaper to fix. CI pipelines make the whole development process faster and more reliable, and they help teams work together more smoothly.
